_help: Regular activities: classes, clubs and groups that meet on a regular pattern. One entry each. Shown in full on the Regular activities page (/regulars/), and as one line each on the Events page and in every newsletter (only entries with a known day, not taking a break), in day order from Monday, then by time. Fields: day (Monday..Sunday; blank = day to be confirmed or varies, listed last on the page only), time (as shown, e.g. 9.45am or 5.30-6.30pm; may be blank), what, where (may be blank), optional frequency (blank = every week; else e.g. '1st Tuesday of the month' or 'Fortnightly'), note (one short line), link {text, url}, until (YYYY-MM-DD: the last day shown, e.g. a block's final session), pausedUntil (YYYY-MM-DD: taking a break, back on this day). Page details (left out when blank): about, runBy, phone, email, website {text, url}, forWho, cost, booking, bring, image {url, alt: a flyer or picture in src/images/items/}, tile (no image: a drawn tile from lib/tiles.js, e.g. yoga, taichi, fitness, coffee; else picked from what and about), checked (YYYY-MM: when the details were last confirmed). detailsElsewhere: true shows no detail rows (e.g. church services). A one-off taster or special night goes in events as usual.
